analysis.method: static source scan plus official documentation sections
analysis.limits: Flags indicate possible source behavior, not exercised runtime behavior. They are not a security proof or a headless compatibility assertion. Original scripts may change preferences, show dialogs or write user settings. Native validation and adapter capabilities are tracked separately.
analysis.script_id_policy: Exact unique JSX filename stem; only catalog IDs may be launched.

scripts.title: Align Text Baseline
scripts.header_description: Allows point texts to be vertically aligned based on the baseline of its font, not its bounds
scripts.description: Allows point texts to be vertically aligned based on the baseline of its font, not its bounds. The native Align panel is tied either to the bounding box of the point text or to the curves via Align to Glyph Bounds, which does not give a consistent result for mixed fonts and sizes.

scripts.title: Align To Artboards
scripts.header_description: Positions objects on document's artboards
scripts.description: The script aligns selected objects to their parent artboards or aligns the contents of all artboards in the document. If the object is on multiple artboards, the script checks which artboard has the center of the object and aligns to it. If the center of the object is outside the artboards, it aligns to the first artboard.

scripts.title: Artboards Finder
scripts.header_description: Search and navigate to artboards by name or size
scripts.description: Search for artboards by name or size and shows the selected artboards in the center of the window. Width and height in document units. Landscape, portrait, square artboards are displayed in descending order of size when searching by orientation.

scripts.title: Artboards Remapper
scripts.header_description: Writes artboard names to a text file or applies from it
scripts.description: Writes artboard names to a text file or applies from it. Actions occur in the range of specified indexes corresponding to numbers in the Artboards panel.

scripts.title: Average Colors
scripts.header_description: Averages the colors of selected objects or separately inside groups or gradients Hold Alt on launch to show dialog if showUI: false or run in silent mode with the latest settings if showUI: true
scripts.description: Averages the colors of selected objects or separately inside groups or gradients. The script skips objects without color or with a pattern. It has two modes: silent and dialog. Changing in CFG.showUI.

scripts.title: Average Strokes Width
scripts.header_description: Averages the stroke width of selected objects, skipping those without strokes. Supports paths, compound paths and text objects
scripts.description: Averages the stroke width of selected objects, skipping those without strokes. Supports paths, compound paths and text objects.

scripts.title: Batch Renamer
scripts.header_description: Script for batch renaming artboards, layers & selected items manually or by placeholders. Find & Replace supports regular expressions.
scripts.description: Batch renames multiple artboards, top-level Layers and selected objects all at once. What it does:

scripts.title: Batch Trace
scripts.header_description: Batch tracing of placed and embedded raster images
scripts.description: Batch tracing of selected placed and embedded images in a document or all images from a user-selected folder. The native menu Object → Image Trace → Make is available for one selected image. Recording the action will not help, because the trace preset are not saved in it. In Adobe Bridge, only the image folder can be traced: Tools → Illustrator → Image Trace.

scripts.title: Beatify Swatch Names
scripts.header_description: A color name finder that suggests visually appealing, descriptive names for selected swatches or all document swatches from a list of over 31,879 names. The database is taken from an open source project "Color Names" https://github.com/meodai/color-names Read disclaimer about offensive and racist names: https://github.com/meodai/color-names#disclaimer-
scripts.description: Assigns unique names to selected colors in the Swatches panel. You can create associative palettes like those found in some corporate brandbooks. Using the script, you can get "Jasmine Green" instead of the default "R=122 G=201 B=67" or "Saffron Gold" instead of "C=0 M=50 Y=100 K=0".

scripts.title: Beatify Swatch Names (Lite)
scripts.header_description: A color name finder that suggests visually appealing, descriptive names for selected swatches or all document swatches from a list of over 4,877 names. The database is taken from an open source project "Color Names" https://github.com/meodai/color-names Read disclaimer about offensive and racist names: https://github.com/meodai/color-names#disclaimer-
scripts.description: Assigns unique names to selected colors in the Swatches panel. You can create associative palettes like those found in some corporate brandbooks. Using the script, you can get "Jasmine Green" instead of the default "R=122 G=201 B=67" or "Saffron Gold" instead of "C=0 M=50 Y=100 K=0".

scripts.title: Center Clips To Artboards
scripts.header_description: Align the clip groups and their contents to the center of the parent artboards
scripts.description: Aligns selected clip groups and their contents to the center of the parent artboards. You can also align all selected clip groups on a single artboard.

scripts.title: Change Opacity
scripts.header_description: Set or shift the Opacity value relative to the current for the selected objects
scripts.description: Controls the opacity of selected objects.

scripts.title: Check Pixel Perfect
scripts.header_description: Checks snapping of path points to pixel grid in 0.5 or 1.0 px increments
scripts.description: Checks snapping of path points to pixel grid in 0.5 or 1.0 px increments. The script selects points with fractional coordinates. Useful for checking the main points of the shape, as points on line curves are difficult to fit on the grid.

scripts.title: Color Blind Simulator
scripts.header_description: Simulates color vision deficiency of 8 types for paths and text. Adobe is limited to two settings in View > Proof Setup. You can use only the preview or recolor your artwork
scripts.description: Simulates color vision deficiency of 8 types. You can recolor objects or use only a preview. Adobe is limited to viewing two types in the View > Proof Setup menu and cannot apply colors. The script supports: paths, compound paths, text, fills and strokes. You can change the gamma correction in CFG.gamma: 2.2 and activate the default preview CFG.defPreview: true.

scripts.title: Color Corrector
scripts.header_description: Adjust color channels for selected objects by setting exact values or calculating relative changes
scripts.description: In Illustrator prior to CS4, you could set the same color channel values for multiple objects. As of CS5, this feature is no longer available. The script allows you to change the fill and stroke channel values as follows

scripts.title: Color Group Replacer
scripts.header_description: Replaces the values of spot colors in one color group with spot colors from another group by matching swatch names or by order
scripts.description: Replaces the values of spot colours in one colour group with spot colours from another group by matching swatch names or by order. In the example, the Default group is replaced. If a color in the target group has the name Accent, the script will look for swatches with a name that contains the name of the target color. You don't need to create palettes with semantic names, just arrange the colors within the groups in the desired order and select the By swatches order option.

scripts.title: Contrast Checker
scripts.header_description: Checks contrast ratio of text or graphics to background color for WCAG 2.1 (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines) compliance For body, subtext, or general copy (font size 17pt/23px and below) - contrast ratio is 4.5:1. For headers or larger text (font size 18pt/24px or 14pt/19px bold and above) - contrast ratio is 3:1. For non-text content (icons and actionable graphics) - contrast ratio is 3:1. WCAG can give a positive result on a bad color pair. You can use the Accessible Perceptual Contrast Algorithm (APCA) calculator, which is more difficult to use.
scripts.description: Helps select color combinations for text and backgrounds, icons and other interface elements, and diagrams by checking the contrast of color pairs for WCAG 2.1 compliance. The auto-correct ratio is set in the script code in the CFG.defRatio: 4.5 variable.

scripts.title: ConvertToGradient
scripts.header_description: Convert a flat process color into a matching gradient
scripts.description: Convert a flat process color into a matching gradient. What's new: The script now works with the RGB and CMYK document profile, Spot & Gray colors. Processes compound paths and groups of items. *Based on original script by Saurabh Sharma, 2010.*

scripts.title: Corners Selector
scripts.header_description: The script will select all anchor points facing in or out
scripts.description: Selects points on objects that are inside or outside the shape of the object. For example, for the task, select all the rays of a star and round them.

scripts.title: Cycle Colors
scripts.header_description: Swap the colors of the selected objects
scripts.description: Swaps the fill and stroke colors of the selected objects in order they have in the Layers panel. Preserves the weight of the strokes, but if an object has no stroke, the script copies one from another object. If your selected objects are in non-consecutive order, you may think that the Forward and Backward buttons move colors randomly. The Reset button doesn't return custom brushes and dash settings applied to strokes, but you You can use the native command Undo after closing the dialog box.

scripts.title: CycleGradient
scripts.header_description: Rearrange colors in a gradient
scripts.description: A set of 4 scripts that change the color order of gradient stops. The position of the stops and opacity don't change.

scripts.title: Cycle Gradient Backward
scripts.header_description: Shifts the colors of gradient stops backward without changing their positions
scripts.description: A set of 4 scripts that change the color order of gradient stops. The position of the stops and opacity don't change.

scripts.title: Cycle Gradient Forward
scripts.header_description: Shifts the colors of gradient stops forward without changing their positions
scripts.description: A set of 4 scripts that change the color order of gradient stops. The position of the stops and opacity don't change.

scripts.title: Cycle Gradient Random
scripts.header_description: Random shuffle the colors of gradient stops without changing their positions
scripts.description: A set of 4 scripts that change the color order of gradient stops. The position of the stops and opacity don't change.

scripts.title: Distribute Gradient Stops
scripts.header_description: Distribute uniform spacing between gradient stops
scripts.description: Distributes uniform spacing between all the gradients stops without changing the position of the outermost stops.

scripts.title: Divide Bottom Path
scripts.header_description: Divide the bottom path by the intersection points with the top paths
scripts.description: Divides the bottom path at the intersections with the top paths. The paths must have a stroke. This script replaces Pathfinder → Outline, which resets the color and doesn't remove the top paths segments. Scissors tool requires precise clicking and takes time with many points.

scripts.title: Document Switcher
scripts.header_description: Displays a list of currently opened documents and allows you to activate any document with a single click
scripts.description: Displays a list of open documents and allows you to activate a document by clicking a line in the list. The list can be filtered by entering part of the name. The first column of the list shows an asterisk * if the document has been modified and not saved. In addition, the name of the active document and the total number of opened or filtered files are displayed.

scripts.title: Draw Path By Selected Points
scripts.header_description: Creates a new path (irregular polygon) by drawing a line between selected points
scripts.description: Draws a polygon based on the selected points. To avoid self-intersections, the script sorts the selected points by polar coordinates from the geometric center of the shape with vertices in points. This is how the drawing direction of the polygon is formed.

scripts.title: Draw Polyline
scripts.header_description: Extends open path ends by adding a segment of given length and angle from selected endpoints
scripts.description: Creates polylines using straight and arc segments. Covers the basic needs for drawing technical diagrams, architectural plans, and packaging die-line.

scripts.title: Draw Rectangles By Artboards
scripts.header_description: Draws rectangles to match the size of each artboard, including any specified bleed
scripts.description: Draws rectangles to the size of the artboards. In the Custom option, you can enter ranges of artboard numbers with commas and hyphens. If the document is saved with bleed settings, the bleed fields will default to this value.

scripts.title: Duplicate Atboards Light
scripts.header_description: Script for copying the selected Artboard with his artwork Requirements: Adobe Illustrator CS6 and later
scripts.description: Script for copying the selected Artboard with his artwork. The Pro version with more options is available at Buymeacoffee

scripts.title: Duplicate To Artboards
scripts.header_description: Copy and paste selected artboard objects to the same position on specific artboards
scripts.description: Duplicates the objects selected on the active artboard to the same position on specific artboards. Artboard numbers are entered with a comma or hyphen. Empty input - objects are duplicated to all artboards except the original artboard. Enable Preserve layers if the selected objects are in different layers and should stay there.

scripts.title: Export Selection As Ai
scripts.header_description: Exports all selected objects to AI files
scripts.description: Exports all selected objects to AI files. *Based on Layers to SVG 0.1 by Anton Ball.*

scripts.title: Export To DXF
scripts.header_description: Export all artboards or selection to separately DXF
scripts.description: Export multiple artboards with visible unlocked contents or selection to separate DXF files for CAD systems.

scripts.title: Extract From Group
scripts.header_description: Extract selected items from parent groups If Alt key is pressed, move item before the first parent group If Alt key is not pressed, move item before the topmost level parent group
scripts.description: Extracts the selected items from parent groups. By default, each item is moved before the top parent group. If Alt / Option (⌥) key is pressed, move item before the first parent group.

scripts.title: Ext Ungroup
scripts.header_description: This script with UI is сan be easily custom ungrouping to all group items, releasing clipping masks in the document. Requirements: Adobe Illustrator CS/CC
scripts.description: Ungroups groups & releases clipping masks, for selected items only or all artwork in the document. *Based on original script by Jiwoong Song & modification by John Wundes.*

scripts.title: File Version Informer
scripts.header_description: Script for collecting information about the version of .ai & .eps files in selected folder & subfolder
scripts.description: Script for collecting information about the program version of .ai & .eps files in selected folder & subfolder.

scripts.title: Fit Artboards To Artwork
scripts.header_description: Resize each artboard by editable artwork size with margins
scripts.description: Fit artboards by the visible unlocked content with custom margins.

scripts.title: Fit Selection To Artboards
scripts.header_description: Proportional resizing of objects to fit one in each artboard
scripts.description: Places selected objects in the center of artboards and optionally fit the largest side of each object to the size of the artboard. When scaling objects, you can set internal paddings from the artboard bounds. With the Rename artboards... option enabled, artboards get names from the objects placed on them.

scripts.title: Fit Selection To Artboards Lite
scripts.header_description: Proportional resizing one selected object to fit in parent artboard
scripts.description: Places selected objects in the center of artboards and optionally fit the largest side of each object to the size of the artboard. When scaling objects, you can set internal paddings from the artboard bounds. With the Rename artboards... option enabled, artboards get names from the objects placed on them.

scripts.title: Grayscale To Opacity
scripts.header_description: Convert selection colors to Grayscale and set identical Opacity value
scripts.description: Convert selection colors to Grayscale and set identical Opacity value.

scripts.title: Group Artboard Objects
scripts.header_description: Group objects on document artboards. Skips locked or hidden objects
scripts.description: The script groups objects on the artboards. It will skip locked or hidden objects. Optionally, you can rename and sort the resulting groups into layers.

scripts.title: Hex To Swatches
scripts.header_description: Create a swatch group from various HEX input formats Supported formats: - Comma-separated: "fb8b24, e36414, 0f4c5c" - Semicolon-separated: "fb8b24; e36414; 0f4c5c" - Space-separated: "fb8b24 e36414 0f4c5c" - Hyphen-separated: "fb8b24-e36414-0f4c5c" - Short HEX: "ebd", "f52", "12fc", "0" - Coolors URL: "https://coolors.co/27187e-758bfd-aeb8fe-f1f2f6-ff8600" - Poolors URL: "https://poolors.com/f78fe2-898415-2e3741" - Copy HEX from https://colorhunt.co/, https://colordesigner.io, learnui.design/tools/data-color-picker.html - Multi-line: Each HEX on a new line
scripts.description: Acts as a "smart clipboard": simply paste any HEX codes or a link from a color generator site (e.g., Coolors) into the input field, and the script instantly creates a color palette in Illustrator. The script recognizes various input formats, with or without the # symbol:

scripts.title: Insert Text
scripts.header_description: Script for inserting text at specific positions within text frames Supports various insertion modes: fixed positions, every N characters, odd/even positions
scripts.description: Inserts or replaces text at specified positions within selected text frames.

scripts.title: Make Envelopes With Tops
scripts.header_description: Make envelopes distort from the top objects. Based on the bottom object
scripts.description: Distorts the selected bottom object by the top selected objects separately. Similar to the multiple run of the command Object > Envelope Distort > Make with Top Object.

scripts.title: Make Numbers Sequence
scripts.header_description: Fills a range of selected text objects with numbers incremented based on the input data
scripts.description: Fills a range of selected text items with numbers incremented based on the input data. Can only replace numbers or {%N} placeholder within the selected text objects.

scripts.title: Make Trapping Stroke
scripts.header_description: Sets the stroke color based on the fill of the object, with the Overprint Stroke attribute enabled, for prepress Based on StrokeColorFromFill.jsx
scripts.description: Sets the stroke color based on the fill of the object, with the Overprint Stroke attribute enabled, for prepress.

scripts.title: Mask Artboards
scripts.header_description: Adds visible unlocked objects on artboards to clipping masks by artboard size
scripts.description: Adds visible unlocked objects on artboards to clipping masks by artboard size. In the Custom option, you can enter ranges of artboard numbers with commas and hyphens. If the document is saved with bleed settings, the bleed fields will default to this value.

scripts.title: Match Colors
scripts.header_description: Matches two groups of objects (paths, texts) or text objecs characters by fill color Warning: Scripts cannot copy/paste gradient angle and length properties Note: Text frames and characters don't support gradient fill
scripts.description: Matches two groups of objects (paths, texts) or text objects characters by fill color. Can recolor selected objects in selected color swatches in the Swatches panel. Colors are defined on paths, compound paths, or text. Other objects in groups are skipped.

scripts.title: Mirror Move
scripts.header_description: Mirror movement the object or points using the last values of the Object > Transform > Move...
scripts.description: Mirror movement the object or points using the last values of the Object > Transform > Move... or last move with the mouse / keyboard. Extends the native Object > Transform > Transform Again. Axes: XY, X, Y. Movement ratio — the ratio of how much distance to move relative to the previous one (1 = the same). It has two modes: silent and dialog. Modes change without editing the code if you hold down the Alt key when running the script:

scripts.title: Move Artboards
scripts.header_description: Script for moving artboards range with artwork along the X and Y axis Requirements: Adobe Illustrator CS6 and later
scripts.description: Script for moving artboards range with artwork along the X and Y axis.

scripts.title: Move To Group
scripts.header_description: Move the selected items to the first upper or lower group
scripts.description: Moves all objects in a selection into a group selected. The order is preserved: the objects above the group are placed inside at the top, the lower ones go at the bottom of the group. If there are several groups in a selection, the dialog allows you to pick between topmost or bottommost groups to be the target.

scripts.title: Multi Edit Text
scripts.header_description: Bulk editing of text frame contents. Replaces content separately or with the same text
scripts.description: Multi-editing of selected text frames. The script allows you to enter the same text, replace the current text frame content or add the entered text to the current one.

scripts.title: Named Items Finder
scripts.header_description: Search items in the document by name and zoom to them contents. Inspired by Photoshop CC 2020 features
scripts.description: Search items in the document by name and zoom to them contents. Inspired by Photoshop CC 2020 features.

scripts.title: Numerates Points
scripts.header_description: Numerates selected points and marks them with colored circles
scripts.description: Numerates selected points and marks them with colored circles.

scripts.title: Objects Counter
scripts.header_description: Counts the number of selected objects
scripts.description: Counts the number of selected objects.

scripts.title: Offset Objects
scripts.header_description: Offsets objects like the native Offset Path command, but works on paths, symbols, rasters and offers additional options
scripts.description: Creates offset paths for any object (text, images, vectors, symbols, brushes) — unlike Illustrator's built-in Offset Path. Uses a custom graphic style (zip-archive include style file).

dependencies.purpose: Graphic style required by original OffsetObjects.jsx

scripts.title: OpacityMaskClip
scripts.header_description: Enable the Clip checkbox for selected objects with opacity masks in the Transparency panel
scripts.description: The script activates Clip checkbox in Transparency > Opacity Mask.

scripts.title: Place Symbols
scripts.header_description: Search and place symbol objects from the Symbols panel on the canvas
scripts.description: Searches the document library for symbols by name and places the selected ones on the canvas. The script speeds up working with a large local symbol library. The Instances column counts all instances of the symbol in the document.

scripts.title: Points Move Random
scripts.header_description: Random movement of selected points in an user range
scripts.description: The script moves randomly in numeric ranges horizontally and vertically selected points or all points on objects. Quick access with Q + underlined key. Instead of Q you can set your modifier key in the script file modKey: 'Q'.

scripts.title: Random Scribble
scripts.header_description: Create random path (scribble) with a given number of points
scripts.description: Creates random paths with a specified number of points. These can be random straight lines from 2 points or complex shapes that imitate scribbles. The points do not go beyond the bounds of the active artboard. If many shapes are first selected in the document, the script will generate individual paths with points into their bounding box.

scripts.title: Random Stroke Width
scripts.header_description: Sets random stroke width of selected objects in a range with steps Hold Alt on launch to show dialog if showUI: false or run in silent mode with the latest settings if showUI: true
scripts.description: Sets random stroke width of selected objects in a range with steps. The stroke unit is taken from Preferences > Units > Stroke. It has two modes: silent and dialog. Changing in CFG.showUI.

scripts.title: Remember Selection Layers
scripts.header_description: Saving and restoring selected items to their original layers. The order within the layers is not restored
scripts.description: Moves objects to their original layers. The information must be saved. The objects are moved to the top of the layer.

scripts.title: Remove Gradient Stops
scripts.header_description: Remove intermediate color stops from the gradients
scripts.description: Removes intermediate color stops of gradient fill and stroke for selected objects.

scripts.title: Rename Artboard As Layer
scripts.header_description: The script renames each Artboard by the custom name of Layer with the first visible unlocked item on it.
scripts.description: The script renames each Artboard by the custom name of Layer with the first visible unlocked item on it.

scripts.title: Rename Artboard As Size
scripts.header_description: The script Renames artboards according to their size in document units
scripts.description: Renames artboards according to their size in document units.

scripts.title: Rename Artboards As Top Object
scripts.header_description: The script renames each Artboard by the custom name of the first visible unlocked item on it
scripts.description: The script renames each Artboard by the custom name of the first visible unlocked item on it. If the top object is text, its contents will be the name of Artboard.

scripts.title: Rename Items
scripts.header_description: Script to batch rename selected items with many options or simple rename one selected item / active layer / artboard
scripts.description: Script to batch rename selected items or their parent layers with many options or simple rename one selected item / active layer / artboard. The find and replace function supports RegExp.

scripts.title: Rename Layer As Text
scripts.header_description: The script renames the layers using the content of the TextFrame or its custom name
scripts.description: Renames layers by name, if any, or by the contents of the text object in the layer. The source is optionally the first top or bottom text in the layer.

scripts.title: Replace Formatted Text
scripts.header_description: Paste text from the clipboard without formatting, preserving the paragraph styles of the original text
scripts.description: Pasting text from the clipboard without formatting, preserving the paragraph styles of the original text. The style is saved from the first character of each paragraph.

scripts.title: Rescale
scripts.header_description: Automatic scaling of objects to the desired size. If you draw a line on top with the length or height of the desired object, 'Old Size' will be filled automatically
scripts.description: Automatic scaling of objects to the desired size. If you draw a line on top with the length or height of the desired object, 'Old Size' will be filled automatically. Units associated with "Document Setup".

scripts.title: Resize On Larger Side
scripts.header_description: resize of the selected objects to the specified amount on the larger side
scripts.description: Resize of the selected objects to the specified amount on the larger side. Works with document units.

scripts.title: Resize To Size
scripts.header_description: Resize each selected object to the entered size
scripts.description: Adobe Illustrator has a Transform panel, but you cannot use it to transform several selected objects to a specified value. It also has problems with the accuracy of the result. The script can transform selected objects with 100% accuracy, depending on the selected side: width, height or automatically the larger side. Units associated with "Document Setup". Quick access with Q + underlined key or digit. Instead of Q you can set your modifier key in the script file modKey: 'Q'.

scripts.title: Reverse Gradient Color
scripts.header_description: Reverse of colors and their gradient transparency. Does not reverse the location of color stops
scripts.description: Reverse the order of gradient colors and their opacity. Does not reverse the locations of color stops.

scripts.title: Round Coordinates
scripts.header_description: The script rounds the coordinates of the center of the object
scripts.description: The script rounds the coordinates of each selected object. The reference point gets from the Transform panel. The script aligns to the stroke if Preferences > Use Preview Bounds is enabled. In the script file, you can change the coordinate rounding step in the CFG step: 1. If the step is 0, the script aligns to the document grid from Preferences > Guides & Grid.

scripts.title: Save All Docs
scripts.header_description: Simple script to save all opened docs
scripts.description: Save all opened docs in one click.

scripts.title: Select All Layers Above
scripts.header_description: Selects the contents of all layers above the active layer
scripts.description: The SelectAllLayersAbove script selects objects in all layers above the active layer. And the SelectAllLayersBelow script is in the layers below. If something is selected in the document, the parent layer of the selected object becomes active. Otherwise, the active layer is the layer that is selected in the Layers panel. Change var isInclActive = false in the code to true so that objects in the source layer are also selected.

scripts.title: Select All Layers Below
scripts.header_description: Selects the contents of all layers below the active layer
scripts.description: The SelectAllLayersAbove script selects objects in all layers above the active layer. And the SelectAllLayersBelow script is in the layers below. If something is selected in the document, the parent layer of the selected object becomes active. Otherwise, the active layer is the layer that is selected in the Layers panel. Change var isInclActive = false in the code to true so that objects in the source layer are also selected.

scripts.title: Select Artboard Objects
scripts.header_description: Select objects overlapping or non-overlapping active artboard with bounds tolerance
scripts.description: Selects all objects that overlap the bounds of the active artboard with a tolerance, or objects outside the bounds. The problem with the native Select → All on Active Artboard function is that it selects entire groups if at least one object in them is on the artboard. The script checks each object individually.

scripts.title: SelectBySwatches
scripts.header_description: Select objects if the stroke color matches the selected swatches
scripts.description: The Magic Wand tool selects objects that match the color of the sample. Selecting samples with the Shift key will select items of different colors. The script will select items if a fill or stroke color matches the colors selected in the Swatches panel.

scripts.title: Select Only Points
scripts.header_description: After using the Lasso tool or Direct Selection Tool, both Points and Path segments are selected. The script leaves only Points selected
scripts.description: After using the Lasso tool A or Direct Selection Tool Q, both Points and Path segments are selected.

scripts.title: SelectPointsByType
scripts.header_description: Selects points on the selected paths according to their type
scripts.description: Selects points on the selected paths according to their type. Does the thing that even Astute Graphics plugins can't do :)

scripts.title: Select Rotated Items
scripts.header_description: Select all editable objects in the document with a rotation angle other than zero radians
scripts.description: Finds rotated objects in a selection or in a document. If isSkipRight: true, then objects rotated 90, 180, 270 degrees are ignored, if false value, then all objects with rotation angle different from 0 degrees are selected.

scripts.title: Set Points Coordinates
scripts.header_description: Sets the path points to the entered X and Y coordinate values. Supports offset delta, similar to the Move menu
scripts.description: Sets the same X, Y coordinates for the selected points. In the native Transform panel, after you type X, Y, the shape moves, not the selected points. The script works with artboard rulers or global rulers toggled in the View → Rulers menu. To move points by a delta, use the double signs -- or ++ in front of the number. If the points have a common coordinate, it is displayed in the input. Illustrator has coordinate inaccuracies, so you can set the CFG.tolerance' in the script code to make the coordinates of the points appear the same in the dialog box.

scripts.title: Show Object Names
scripts.header_description: Shows names of vector objects, linked or embedded raster images
scripts.description: Adds file names of placed or embedded images (PNG, JPG, TIFF, PSD, PDF and others) and the names of other selected objects, as well as artboards. If the source image file is not found in the folder, the script adds "Missing Image". For objects without a name, the caption is "Unnamed Object". In version 0.4, captions are created with the selected character style.

scripts.title: Show Object Names
scripts.header_description: Shows names of vector objects, linked or embedded raster images
scripts.description: Adds file names of placed or embedded images (PNG, JPG, TIFF, PSD, PDF and others) and the names of other selected objects, as well as artboards. If the source image file is not found in the folder, the script adds "Missing Image". For objects without a name, the caption is "Unnamed Object". In version 0.4, captions are created with the selected character style.

scripts.title: Sort Layer Items
scripts.header_description: Sort objects alphabetically inside of a layer
scripts.description: Sorts objects alphabetically inside layers. The sublayers are sorted with the objects and when you select Include all sublayers their contents too. The layer count is automatically updated. Objects without a name (in pointy brackets , , etc.) are placed top / bottom.

scripts.title: SplitPath
scripts.header_description: Script for subtract Shapes from Paths. Pathfinder in Illustrator does not do it =) Requirements: Adobe Illustrator CS6 and above
scripts.description: Powerfull script for subtract shapes from paths. Pathfinder panel in Adobe Illustrator does not do it.

scripts.title: Stroke Color From Fill
scripts.header_description: Sets a stroke color of an object based on an its solid or gradient fill.
scripts.description: Applies a color from its solid or gradient fill to the stroke of each selected path. If the fill is a gradient, the colors of all gradient stops are averaged for the stroke color.

scripts.title: Strokes Weight Down
scripts.header_description: Reduces the weight of the strokes of the selected paths relative to the current weight
scripts.description: A set of two scripts that adjust the stroke weight of selected paths relative to their current values. StrokesWeightDown decreases and StrokesWeightUp increases the weight by a fixed amount based on your current settings (Preferences → Units → Stroke):

scripts.title: Strokes Weight Up
scripts.header_description: Increases the weight of the strokes of the selected paths relative to the current weight
scripts.description: A set of two scripts that adjust the stroke weight of selected paths relative to their current values. StrokesWeightDown decreases and StrokesWeightUp increases the weight by a fixed amount based on your current settings (Preferences → Units → Stroke):

scripts.title: Subtract Top Path
scripts.header_description: Subtracts the top path from all those below it
scripts.description: Subtracts the top selected shape from all the shapes below it. Pathfinder panel in Adobe Illustrator does not do it. Change the value of isRmvTop to false to keep the original shape. The isUseFS: true speeds up processing with a large number of objects.

scripts.title: Swap Objects
scripts.header_description: Swaps the coordinates of two selected objects by reference point and the order within the layer optionally
scripts.description: Swaps the coordinates of two selected objects by reference point and the order within the layer optionally.

scripts.title: Sync Global Colors Names
scripts.header_description: Syncs the names of the same global colors between open documents
scripts.description: Syncs the names of the same global colors between open documents. After that, all changes will be saved.

scripts.title: Text Block
scripts.header_description: Convert selected point text objects into a block of text
scripts.description: Creates a block of selected text layers with specified width and spacing. The order of the layers in the block corresponds to the order of the original layers on the Y-axis. Layers are grouped together. Supported units: px, pt, in, mm, cm, m, ft, and yd.

scripts.title: Transform Points
scripts.header_description: Unlike Illustrator's native tools, this script allows you to enter exact dimensions for any selection of anchor points
scripts.description: Unlike the standard Transform panel, Scale tool, or Free Transform tool, this script lets you enter exact dimensions (Width + Height) based on the bounding box of selected path points — similar to how Affinity works. If two points are selected, you can also control the line's length and angle.

scripts.title: Triangle Maker
scripts.header_description: Draws a triangle with dimensions for one or two sides and angle(s)
scripts.description: Creates a triangle of a given size by sides and angles at the center of the screen or from a selected anchor point. Calculates the length of the three sides and angles in degrees. Optionally, display triangle dimensions in text near the triangle — *Add Triangle Data As Text*.

scripts.title: Trim Masks
scripts.header_description: Automatic trimming of all clipping groups in a document using Pathfinder > Crop
scripts.description: Automatically trims all clip groups in a selection or a document using Pathfinder > Crop.

scripts.title: Trim Open Ends
scripts.header_description: Removes the ends of open paths up to their intersection points
scripts.description: Removes the ends of open paths up to their intersection points. It's an alternative to the Shape Builder tool.

scripts.title: Zoom and Center
scripts.header_description: Zooms active view to all object(s) in a document or to selection. Used code from FitArtboardToArt.jsx by Darryl Zurn
scripts.description: Zooms active view to selection or to all object(s) in a document. If you want a different scale ratio, open the script file with a text editor and change the SCALE_RATIO = .75;. *Based on original script by John Wundes.*
